decision: Use the Ramsar record to scope the Sasmuan coastal-wetland complex and retain the 2017 Batang Dos participatory assessment's local fishery-resource names only as historical community-reported labels. The assessment itself says fish identification is still to be determined; do not turn its mixed fish/crustacean/mollusc names into scientific taxa or current presence claims.

siteScope.name: Sasmuan Pampanga Coastal Wetlands (Ramsar Site 2445)
sourceReportedHabitatComponents: intertidal mud, sand or salt flats
siteScope.relatedLocalStudyArea: Bangkung Malapad / Barangay Batang Dos; this is one barangay-level study area, not the whole Ramsar site.
siteScope.geometryDecision: The Ramsar record reports an official area and a separate GIS-calculated area and exposes a site GIS download. No geometry was fetched, checked, or added to Bangwit. The Ramsar conservation-site boundary is not a municipal-water boundary or a fish occurrence polygon.

sources.title: RIS for Site no. 2445, Sasmuan Pampanga Coastal Wetlands, Philippines
sources.access: Official Ramsar Information Sheet PDF and site page reviewed. The RIS states the two different area figures and identifies connected wetland types and five coastal barangays.
sources.reuse: No item-specific reuse license for its attached reports, maps or species tables was verified. No map, image or substantial report text is reproduced.

sources.title: Participatory Coastal Resource Assessment (PCRA) of Brgy. Batang Dos, Sasmuan, Pampanga 2017
sources.sourceReportedScope: Barangay Batang Dos and Bangkung Malapad; do not generalize to all five Ramsar barangays.
sources.sourceReportedMethod: Participatory coastal-resource assessment with community/key-informant resource labels; it is not a taxonomic fish survey and provides no voucher or scientific-name crosswalk for the fishery labels.
sources.sourceReportedAssessmentStatement: The report's summary lists Fish as 'to be determined'. Its combined fish/crustacean/mollusc prompt nevertheless records 26 labels under PRESENT and two under PAST.
sources.reuse: The attachment is public on the Ramsar site page, but no item-specific open reuse license was identified. Keep labels attributed and out of public app data pending taxonomy and rights review.

sources.title: Community Resource Assessment and Ground Validation of the Proposed Sasmuan Critical Habitat and Ecotourism Area
sources.access: Ramsar-attached 36-page assessment reviewed. It discusses fisheries, fishponds and some local fishery terms, but its recommendations call for a future aquatic-fauna inventory and profiling; it is not a fish checklist.
sources.reuse: No item-specific open reuse license was identified. No tables, photos or report prose are reproduced.

sources.title: DENR PENRO Pampanga Data of ASEAN Waterbird Census for 2010-2020 (Ramsar taxonomic-list attachment)
sources.access: Eight-page attachment reviewed; its list is waterbirds, not a fish taxonomic checklist. The RIS's generic 'taxonomic lists of plant and animal species' attachment label therefore does not provide fish identities in this file.
sources.disposition: Useful bird-monitoring source only; do not treat as fish evidence.

interpretationLimits: The prompt combines fishes, crustaceans and mollusks; not every label is a fish.
The table contains 26 present labels despite saying 'Top ten'.
Local/common labels can be ambiguous across taxa and places; no scientific-name normalization is justified from this document alone.
The report separately says fish identification is 'to be determined', so present/past are source-reported community categories from 2017, not current app occurrence status.
The approximate pieces-per-kilogram values are market/size descriptions, not population estimates or abundance and are not transcribed here.

nextStep: Review the 2020 Pampanga estuary dry-season fish-community study as a separate, zone-based estuary dataset. Verify its exact stations, taxon table access, reuse terms and connection to the Ramsar site before comparing it with the Batang Dos community labels. Central Luzon remains incomplete.
